By leveraging Google's Generative AI models paired with Python's asynchronous Discord wrappers, the bot goes beyond simple command-and-response paradigms.\\n\\n### System Architecture\\nThe core system is built on a modular Python architecture featuring:\\n- **State Management**: Context-aware conversation tracking to remember prior interactions within threads.\\n- **Intent Detection**: Pre-processing user inputs to accurately route complex queries to the proper internal sub-modules (e.g., moderation vs. general conversation).\\n- **Asynchronous Execution**: Allowing the bot to handle high-volume server events without blocking the main event loop.\\n\\n*(More documentation available on the GitHub repository).*\\n\""]],"tooltipText":""}}
